definitions.label: Meaning
definitions.guidance: Living beings; natural world; made objects; mental life; social life; grammatical or logical structure.

definitions.label: Topic
definitions.guidance: Choose relevant conversational domains; general includes subjects outside these domains.

definitions.label: Senses
definitions.guidance: Different uses of this exact form; bank has multiple senses; water has everyday and technical uses.

definitions.label: Abstractness
definitions.guidance: Physical referent versus concept, event, quality or relation; mixed when senses differ.

definitions.label: Entity type
definitions.guidance: What the word can denote in its attested senses.

definitions.label: Action type
definitions.guidance: Kinds of action expressed; use not applicable for words that express no action.

definitions.label: Properties
definitions.guidance: Properties or states named or described by the word.

definitions.label: Semantic relations
definitions.guidance: Semantic relation the word EXPRESSES, not a claim about an unspecified synonym. Examples: alike, unlike, part, type, cause, related.

definitions.label: Part of speech
definitions.guidance: All applicable parts of speech; function includes prepositions, conjunctions, particles and interjections. Water is noun AND verb.

definitions.label: Word structure
definitions.guidance: Morphological structure; select all applicable features of the exact spelling.

definitions.label: Inflection
definitions.guidance: Grammatical forms, including comparative/superlative; exact form may have multiple analyses.

definitions.label: Countability
definitions.guidance: Noun countability; water is usually mass but can mean servings. Other word classes may be not applicable.

definitions.label: Agreement
definitions.guidance: Explicit person/number properties of the word; invariant when form does not distinguish them.

definitions.label: Tense
definitions.guidance: Tense or temporal reference actually signaled by the word; not every noun has a tense.

definitions.label: Aspect
definitions.guidance: Aspect expressed or licensed by this form; progressive be + ing; perfect have + participle.

definitions.label: Modality
definitions.guidance: Modal meaning such as can, might, must, may, will or would.

definitions.label: Valency
definitions.guidance: Verb complement patterns; give can take two objects; depend takes a prepositional complement.

definitions.label: Voice
definitions.guidance: Grammatical voice or voice-compatible form; passive usually be + past participle.

definitions.label: Sentence role
definitions.guidance: All plausible sentence roles across common uses, not one mandatory position.

definitions.label: Noun phrase role
definitions.guidance: Role inside noun phrases, e.g. the warm water: determiner, premodifier, head.

definitions.label: Verb phrase role
definitions.guidance: Role inside verb phrases; can + BASE verb, have + participle, be + ing/passive participle.

definitions.label: Preceding structure
definitions.guidance: Structures that can license this word next. After modal choose base verb; after determiner a noun phrase.

definitions.label: Following structure
definitions.guidance: Constituent commonly licensed after the word. Do not invent a single mandatory successor.

definitions.label: Position
definitions.guidance: Permitted positions across ordinary grammatical contexts.

definitions.label: Collocation
definitions.guidance: Collocation patterns the word participates in, e.g. make tea, strong coffee. These are pattern tags, not invented lexical partners.

definitions.label: Complements
definitions.guidance: Complement construction patterns, e.g. want to go, enjoy reading, depend on something.

definitions.label: Logic
definitions.guidance: Logical links actually expressed by the word.

definitions.label: Sequence
definitions.guidance: Temporal ordering or repetition expressed by the word.

definitions.label: Intent
definitions.guidance: Communicative purposes the word commonly supports. Social includes greeting, apology, thanks.

definitions.label: Answer role
definitions.guidance: Common discourse functions, not an assertion that every word has a unique function.

definitions.label: Procedure
definitions.guidance: Procedural role: water as ingredient, kettle as tool, heat as action, minutes as duration.

definitions.label: Reference
definitions.guidance: Reference/deixis: she, it, here, then, this, one. Content nouns may be generic or not applicable.

definitions.label: Sentiment
definitions.guidance: Typical sentiment or emotion expressed; neutral is an assessment, not missing data.

definitions.label: Certainty
definitions.guidance: Epistemic certainty/evidence expressed: definitely, likely, perhaps, allegedly, seen.

definitions.label: Register
definitions.guidance: Registers in which this word naturally occurs; multiple labels permitted.

definitions.label: Frequency
definitions.guidance: Qualitative usage estimate, not measured corpus frequency. Choose uncertain if unsupported.
